name: Air Cup Kit - Tankless Front Kit
desc: This beauty of an air cup suspension provides the ability to raise your car up to 2 inches at a moments notice AND have the reliability/trackability of a coilover setup. This will allow you to avoid obstacles on the road to protect your investment. Additionally, Kuya will exchange the size to fit your coilovers. If you need a set of coilovers, this bid INCLUDES a discount on a new set of coilovers! Check it out at Kuya Auto's site!

name: RFY NSX Racing Oil Pan
desc: This upgraded racing oil pan is a must have for every NSX owner. It is made from aluminum die-casting and increases oil capacity by approximately 1.4 qts. Designed to support extended driving sessions, it helps manage the peak oil temperatures of the high-heat C30-series engines commonly used in motorsports. Additionally, the included anti-slosh plate addresses one of the NSX's known weaknesses—oil pressure drop during right-hand turns—by minimizing oil mist contamination into blow-by gas and stabilizing oil delivery under high G-forces. Check it out on the Valiants Racing site!

name: NSX 100% full Carbon Fiber Replacement Exterior Side Body Vent
desc: A set of full 100% carbon fiber center replacement exterior side vents for your 1991+ NSX. Not only are these new direct replacement side vent trims super light weight and strong, they look AMAZING and guaranteed to fit perfectly without any broken tabs! NO CORE EXCHANGE NEEDED. Get more info on the Euro Boutique site!

name: Honda Motocompacto
desc: Honda believes the future of clean transportation is already here and powerfully revolutionized with the Motocompacto. Earning a category all its own, Motocompacto is personal mobility designed like a dream. It fits perfectly into compact spaces, dynamic commutes, and individual styles. Designed, engineered and tested by Honda, Motocompacto delivers the company’s signature durability, quality and reliability in personal electric transportation. Simple, elegant and approachable, Motocompacto is built for competitive performance. Get more info, and product specs, on Honda's Motocompacto site! And if you don't end up winning, don't worry! You can still puchase one at Pembroke Pines Acura!

name: Acura NSX (NA1 / NA2) 1991–2005 Subframe Replacement Bushings: Front
desc: Factory subframe bushings deteriorate over time, leading to cracking, slop, and excessive suspension deflection regardless of mileage. Honda does not sell replacement bushings separately—requiring the purchase of expensive complete subframe beams. Enter Pride Exhaust, bringing you a solution that replaces worn factory rubber bushings, resisting dry rotting and cracking under load. You can learn more at the Pride Exhaust site!

name: Acura NSX (NC1) 2017–2022 Lower Intercooler Hose Set
desc: Factory rubber intercooler hoses are soft and the worm-gear clamps are a known weak point on the 2nd Gen NSX—even on stock-boost vehicles. Under high boost pressures OEM hoses can stretch, swell, or completely come loose under load. This can even trigger limp mode on the road, or the track. Pride has a solution engineered for track reliability and high-boost consistency, their direct-replacement silicone intercooler hose kit locks your charge pipes in place permanently. You can find out more on the Pride Exhaust site!
